examples.text_en: We need his expertise on this matter.
examples.text_zh: 在这件事上我们需要他的专门技术。

examples.text_en: Her expertise in law is widely respected.
examples.text_zh: 她在法律方面的专门技术广受尊敬。

examples.text_en: He tried to expiate his past wrongs.
examples.text_zh: 他努力补偿自己过去的过错。

examples.text_en: Nothing can expiate such a crime.
examples.text_zh: 没有什么能补偿这样的罪行。

examples.text_en: He saw the long work as an expiation.
examples.text_zh: 他把这项长期工作看作一种赎罪。

examples.text_en: The expiation of his wrongs took many years.
examples.text_zh: 他为过错赎罪花了许多年。

examples.text_en: The expiration of the lease is near.
examples.text_zh: 租约的满期快到了。

examples.text_en: Check the expiration date on the milk.
examples.text_zh: 看看牛奶上的满期日期。

examples.text_en: His long silence was explicable to all of us.
examples.text_zh: 他长久的沉默我们都能理解。

examples.text_en: The change was explicable by a simple fact.
examples.text_zh: 这个变化可以用一个简单的事实来解释。

examples.text_en: The teacher will explicate the difficult poem.
examples.text_zh: 老师将详细说明这首难懂的诗。

examples.text_en: He explicated the rules to the class.
examples.text_zh: 他向全班详细解释了这些规则。

examples.text_en: He gave explicit instructions to the team.
examples.text_zh: 他给团队下达了清楚的指示。

examples.text_en: Her answer was clear and explicit.
examples.text_zh: 她的回答清楚而明白。

examples.text_en: The exploitation of the land brought much money.
examples.text_zh: 对这片土地的开发带来了很多钱。

examples.text_en: They spoke against the exploitation of young workers.
examples.text_zh: 他们反对剥削年轻工人。

examples.text_en: The bomb contained a powerful explosive.
examples.text_zh: 这枚炸弹含有一种强力炸药。

examples.text_en: Police removed the explosive from the site.
examples.text_zh: 警方从现场移走了炸药。

examples.text_en: He was a leading exponent of the new way.
examples.text_zh: 他是这种新方法的主要倡导者。

examples.text_en: The exponent showed how the numbers grow fast.
examples.text_zh: 这个指数说明了数字增长得有多快。

examples.text_en: The cost of the work grew exponentially last year.
examples.text_zh: 去年这项工作的成本呈指数式增长。

examples.text_en: Their small idea grew exponentially in a few months.
examples.text_zh: 他们的小想法在几个月里迅速成倍扩大。

examples.text_en: The book has a clear and expository style.
examples.text_zh: 这本书的风格清楚而具说明性。

examples.text_en: He wrote an expository note about the plan.
examples.text_zh: 他写了一份说明这个计划的文字。

examples.text_en: She would expostulate with him about his plan.
examples.text_zh: 她会就他的计划向他提出劝告。

examples.text_en: They tried to expostulate with the young man.
examples.text_zh: 他们设法规劝这个年轻人。

examples.text_en: The exposure of the truth took a long time.
examples.text_zh: 真相的揭露花了很长时间。

examples.text_en: His exposure to the cold made him ill.
examples.text_zh: 他受冻之后病倒了。

examples.text_en: He will expound the plan at the next meeting.
examples.text_zh: 他将在下次会议上详细说明这个计划。

examples.text_en: She tried to expound her idea to the group.
examples.text_zh: 她设法向团队阐释自己的想法。

examples.text_en: He came expressly to see you.
examples.text_zh: 他特意来看你。

examples.text_en: The rule expressly forbids such acts.
examples.text_zh: 这条规定明确地禁止此类行为。

examples.text_en: The state may expropriate private land.
examples.text_zh: 国家可以征用私人土地。

examples.text_en: They expropriated his farm for the road.
examples.text_zh: 他们为了修路没收了他的农场。

examples.text_en: His expulsion from the club surprised everyone.
examples.text_zh: 他被逐出俱乐部让大家都很吃惊。

examples.text_en: They talked about the expulsion of the young man.
examples.text_zh: 他们谈到了对那个年轻人的开除。

examples.text_en: They will expunge his name from the list.
examples.text_zh: 他们会把他的名字从名单上删去。

examples.text_en: He tried to expunge the note from the book.
examples.text_zh: 他设法把那张便条从书里去掉。

examples.text_en: The editor chose to expurgate the text.
examples.text_zh: 编辑选择删除文中的部分内容。

examples.text_en: They expurgated the book before printing.
examples.text_zh: 他们在印刷前删改了这本书。

examples.text_en: Only three copies are still extant.
examples.text_zh: 只有三份抄本还现存。

examples.text_en: The museum owns the only extant painting.
examples.text_zh: 博物馆拥有唯一现存的那幅画。

examples.text_en: His extemporaneous talk was short but very good.
examples.text_zh: 他的即席发言虽短，却非常好。

examples.text_en: She gave an extemporaneous answer to the question.
examples.text_zh: 她对这个问题作了即席的回答。

examples.text_en: The pianist began to extemporize softly.
examples.text_zh: 钢琴家开始轻柔地即兴演奏。

examples.text_en: He had to extemporize a short speech.
examples.text_zh: 他不得不即席演说一段简短的话。

examples.text_en: Nothing can extenuate the weight of that loss.
examples.text_zh: 什么也无法减轻那次损失的沉重。

examples.text_en: They tried to extenuate his part in the fight.
examples.text_zh: 他们试图为他在这场争执中的责任开脱。

examples.text_en: The exterior of the house needs paint.
examples.text_zh: 房子的外部需要粉刷。

examples.text_en: They admired the building's fine exterior.
examples.text_zh: 他们欣赏这座建筑精美的外部。

examples.text_en: They tried to exterminate the small animals.
examples.text_zh: 他们想消灭这些小动物。

examples.text_en: We must exterminate this bad idea at once.
examples.text_zh: 我们必须立刻根除这个坏想法。

examples.text_en: He tried to externalize his feeling in a song.
examples.text_zh: 他设法用一首歌把自己的感受表达出来。

examples.text_en: They externalize their ideas in a simple form.
examples.text_zh: 他们把自己的想法表现为一种简单的形式。

examples.text_en: The extirpation of the disease took years.
examples.text_zh: 根除这种疾病花了好几年。

examples.text_en: They worked for the extirpation of the weed.
examples.text_zh: 他们致力于根除这种杂草。

examples.text_en: Many poems extol the beauty of spring.
examples.text_zh: 许多诗歌颂扬春天的美。

examples.text_en: The critics extolled her latest film.
examples.text_zh: 评论家们称赞她最新的影片。

examples.text_en: The gang tried to extort money from him.
examples.text_zh: 这个团伙试图向他勒索钱财。

examples.text_en: They extorted a large sum from the firm.
examples.text_zh: 他们从这家公司敲诈了一大笔钱。

examples.text_en: The dentist performed a careful tooth extraction.
examples.text_zh: 牙医做了一次小心的牙齿拔出术。

examples.text_en: The extraction of the oil took hours.
examples.text_zh: 石油的抽出花了好几个小时。

examples.text_en: She takes part in many extracurricular things at school.
examples.text_zh: 她在学校参加许多课外活动。

examples.text_en: The extracurricular work took all his free time.
examples.text_zh: 课外活动占用了他全部的空闲时间。

examples.text_en: The court agreed to extradite the man.
examples.text_zh: 法院同意引渡这个人。

examples.text_en: They refused to extradite him to France.
examples.text_zh: 他们拒绝把他引渡到法国。

examples.text_en: We must cut the extraneous words from the report.
examples.text_zh: 我们必须删去报告中多余的字句。

examples.text_en: His extraneous ideas made the talk too long.
examples.text_zh: 他那些无关的想法让谈话太长了。

examples.text_en: We can extrapolate the answer from these few facts.
examples.text_zh: 我们可以从这几个事实推断出答案。

examples.text_en: They tried to extrapolate the growth for next year.
examples.text_zh: 他们设法推算出明年的增长。

examples.text_en: Her extravagance soon emptied the account.
examples.text_zh: 她的奢侈很快花光了账户里的钱。

examples.text_en: He regretted the extravagance of his youth.
examples.text_zh: 他后悔年轻时的浪费。

examples.text_en: The extremist had few friends in the town.
examples.text_zh: 这个偏激的人在镇上朋友很少。

examples.text_en: They did not want an extremist on the team.
examples.text_zh: 他们不想让偏激的人进入团队。

examples.text_en: The storm drove them to extremity.
examples.text_zh: 风暴把他们逼到了绝境。

examples.text_en: He endured the extremity of the cold.
examples.text_zh: 他忍受了寒冷的极端。

examples.text_en: The problem is extricable with a little help.
examples.text_zh: 只要有人帮忙，这个问题是可以解决的。

examples.text_en: They believed the man was extricable from the debt.
examples.text_zh: 他们相信这个人能摆脱债务。

examples.text_en: They helped extricate the car from mud.
examples.text_zh: 他们帮忙把小汽车从泥里解救出来。

examples.text_en: He tried to extricate himself from the deal.
examples.text_zh: 他试图使自己从这笔交易中解脱出来。

examples.text_en: The reward was extrinsic and did not last.
examples.text_zh: 这种奖励是外在的，不会长久。

examples.text_en: He cared about extrinsic things like money.
examples.text_zh: 他在意的是金钱之类的外在之物。

examples.text_en: The extrovert made friends with everyone at work.
examples.text_zh: 这个外向的人在工作中和每个人都交上了朋友。

examples.text_en: She is an extrovert and loves a big party.
examples.text_zh: 她性格外向，喜欢热闹的聚会。

examples.text_en: The machine can extrude a long line of gold.
examples.text_zh: 这台机器能把黄金挤成长长的一条。

examples.text_en: They extrude the hot metal into a fine form.
examples.text_zh: 他们把滚烫的金属挤压成细长的形状。

examples.text_en: The exuberance of the young team was clear.
examples.text_zh: 这支年轻队伍的勃勃生气一目了然。

examples.text_en: He met the news with great exuberance and joy.
examples.text_zh: 他听到这个消息时欣喜万分。

examples.text_en: The garden had an exuberant show of green.
examples.text_zh: 花园里草木繁茂，一片翠绿。

examples.text_en: She was exuberant and full of new plans.
examples.text_zh: 她生气勃勃，满脑子新计划。

examples.text_en: The exultant team ran out to meet the crowd.
examples.text_zh: 欢欣的队伍跑出去迎接人群。

examples.text_en: She was exultant after the great win.
examples.text_zh: 大获全胜之后，她欢欣不已。

examples.text_en: She wore an eye-catching red dress.
examples.text_zh: 她穿了一件引人注目的红裙子。

examples.text_en: The poster has an eye-catching design.
examples.text_zh: 这张海报有一个引人注目的设计。

examples.text_en: An eyewitness described the scene clearly.
examples.text_zh: 一名目击者清楚地描述了现场。

examples.text_en: The police questioned a key eyewitness.
examples.text_zh: 警方讯问了一位关键的目击者。

examples.text_en: They had to fabricate a new part.
examples.text_zh: 他们必须制造一个新零件。

examples.text_en: He tried to fabricate a clever excuse.
examples.text_zh: 他试图编造一个巧妙的借口。

examples.text_en: The story was a complete fabrication.
examples.text_zh: 这个故事纯属虚构的谎言。

examples.text_en: They accused him of pure fabrication.
examples.text_zh: 他们指责他纯属虚构。

examples.text_en: The film star had a recent facelift.
examples.text_zh: 这位影星最近做了整容手术。

examples.text_en: A facelift can cost a lot of money.
examples.text_zh: 整容手术可能花费很多钱。

examples.text_en: This is one facet of the problem.
examples.text_zh: 这是这个问题的一个方面。

examples.text_en: The diamond has a bright facet.
examples.text_zh: 这颗钻石有一个明亮的琢面。

examples.text_en: Stop making facetious comments in class.
examples.text_zh: 别在课堂上说爱开玩笑的话。

examples.text_en: His facetious remark annoyed the teacher.
examples.text_zh: 他滑稽的言辞惹恼了老师。

examples.text_en: The work was facile for such a good team.
examples.text_zh: 对这样出色的团队来说，这活儿很轻松。

examples.text_en: He gave a facile answer to the hard question.
examples.text_zh: 他对这个难题给了个轻巧的回答。

examples.text_en: Good roads facilitate trade between towns.
examples.text_zh: 良好的道路促进了城镇之间的贸易。

examples.text_en: The new tool will facilitate our work.
examples.text_zh: 新工具会帮助我们开展工作。

examples.text_en: The new policy aims at facilitation of trade.
examples.text_zh: 新政策旨在为贸易提供便利。

examples.text_en: His help was a real facilitation.
examples.text_zh: 他的帮助确实是一种助力。

examples.text_en: The school has good sports facilities.
examples.text_zh: 这所学校有良好的运动设施。

examples.text_en: The hotel offers excellent facilities for guests.
examples.text_zh: 这家旅馆为客人提供优良的设施。

examples.text_en: The new facility will open soon.
examples.text_zh: 新设施很快就要开放。

examples.text_en: This facility serves the entire region.
examples.text_zh: 这个设施为整个地区服务。

examples.text_en: A small faction left the group last year.
examples.text_zh: 一个小派系去年脱离了团体。

examples.text_en: The faction caused a lot of trouble in the group.
examples.text_zh: 这个派系在团体里惹了不少麻烦。

examples.text_en: The factious group could not work together.
examples.text_zh: 这个好搞派系的团体无法合作。

examples.text_en: He was a factious man and loved a good fight.
examples.text_zh: 他爱拉帮结派，喜欢争斗。

examples.text_en: Her smile was factitious and did not reach her eyes.
examples.text_zh: 她的笑是装出来的，眼里没有笑意。

examples.text_en: The factitious joy made everyone feel uneasy.
examples.text_zh: 这种做作的喜悦让大家都不自在。

examples.text_en: That large number is easily factorable.
examples.text_zh: 那个大数很容易分解因子。

examples.text_en: Only some large numbers are factorable.
examples.text_zh: 只有部分大数可以分解因子。

examples.text_en: The factotum did many different jobs.
examples.text_zh: 这位杂役做了许多不同的工作。

examples.text_en: Their factotum handled all the small tasks.
examples.text_zh: 他们的家务总管处理所有琐事。

examples.text_en: The report is clear and factual.
examples.text_zh: 这份报告清楚而属实。

examples.text_en: We need a factual account of events.
examples.text_zh: 我们需要一份对事件如实的叙述。

examples.text_en: The new fad did not last more than a year.
examples.text_zh: 这个新时尚没持续超过一年。

examples.text_en: Every young person followed the fad that summer.
examples.text_zh: 那年夏天每个年轻人都追这股风潮。

examples.text_en: The design was faddish and soon out of date.
examples.text_zh: 这个设计赶时髦，很快就过时了。

examples.text_en: Faddish things never stay long in the market.
examples.text_zh: 赶时髦的东西在市场上留不长久。

examples.text_en: That long task was a real fag.
examples.text_zh: 那项漫长的任务真是件苦工。

examples.text_en: The chores felt like a heavy fag.
examples.text_zh: 这些杂活让人觉得是一项沉重的苦工。

examples.text_en: He carried a fagot of dry wood.
examples.text_zh: 他抱着一捆干柴。

examples.text_en: A fagot of sticks lay by the fire.
examples.text_zh: 一束柴把放在火边。

examples.text_en: The system has a fail-safe device.
examples.text_zh: 这个系统有一个自动防故障装置。

examples.text_en: We need a fail-safe plan for the launch.
examples.text_zh: 我们需要一个自动防故障的发射方案。

examples.text_en: The fainthearted boy did not want to go.
examples.text_zh: 这个胆小的男孩不愿去。

examples.text_en: They called him fainthearted for staying home.
examples.text_zh: 他们说他胆小，只敢待在家里。

examples.text_en: Her faithfulness to the team never faded.
examples.text_zh: 她对团队的忠诚从未消退。

examples.text_en: He admired his dog's simple faithfulness.
examples.text_zh: 他赞赏自己狗那份单纯的忠诚。

examples.text_en: The falconer walked out with a big bird.
examples.text_zh: 养鹰人带着一只大鸟走了出去。

examples.text_en: A good falconer knows how to call his bird.
examples.text_zh: 好养鹰人懂得怎样召唤自己的鹰。

examples.text_en: Two falcons circled above the field.
examples.text_zh: 两只猎鹰在田野上空盘旋。

examples.text_en: The falcons nest on the high cliffs.
examples.text_zh: 那些猎鹰在高高的悬崖上筑巢。

examples.text_en: That idea is a common fallacy.
examples.text_zh: 那个想法是一种常见的谬见。

examples.text_en: He exposed the fallacy in her argument.
examples.text_zh: 他揭示了她的论证里那个错误的观念。

examples.text_en: The fallibility of the plan was clear to us.
examples.text_zh: 这个方案容易出错，我们看得很清楚。

examples.text_en: He talked about the fallibility of human sense.
examples.text_zh: 他谈到人的判断容易出错。

examples.text_en: Every judge is human and fallible.
examples.text_zh: 每个法官都是人，都可能犯错。

examples.text_en: Even experts are fallible in such cases.
examples.text_zh: 在这类事情上连专家也可能犯错。

examples.text_en: The farmer left the field fallow.
examples.text_zh: 农民让这块地成了休耕地。

examples.text_en: The fallow field lay quiet all winter.
examples.text_zh: 这块休耕地整个冬天静静地躺着。

examples.text_en: He told a plain falsehood to us.
examples.text_zh: 他对我们撒了一个明显的谎言。

examples.text_en: The report was full of falsehood.
examples.text_zh: 这份报告满是谎言。

examples.text_en: He began to falter when they asked about the money.
examples.text_zh: 当他们问起钱的事，他开始支支吾吾。

examples.text_en: She would falter over every hard question.
examples.text_zh: 每遇到难题她都会支吾其词。

examples.text_en: Familiarity with the rules helps a lot.
examples.text_zh: 熟悉规则大有帮助。

examples.text_en: His familiarity with the city surprised us.
examples.text_zh: 他对这座城市的熟悉让我们惊讶。

examples.text_en: Please familiarize yourself with the rules.
examples.text_zh: 请使你自己熟悉这些规则。

examples.text_en: She familiarized the team with the plan.
examples.text_zh: 她让团队熟悉了这个计划。

examples.text_en: The long drought led to famine.
examples.text_zh: 长期的干旱导致了饥荒。

examples.text_en: Thousands fled the famine in the north.
examples.text_zh: 数千人逃离了北方的饥荒。

examples.text_en: The long march would famish the troops.
examples.text_zh: 漫长的行军会使部队挨饿。

examples.text_en: They were famished after the long walk.
examples.text_zh: 长途步行后他们饿坏了。

examples.text_en: He is fanatical about clean streets.
examples.text_zh: 他对街道整洁十分狂热。

examples.text_en: The crowd was fanatical in its support.
examples.text_zh: 这群人的支持十分狂热。

examples.text_en: Their fanaticism made a real talk impossible.
examples.text_zh: 他们的狂热让真正的交谈无法进行。

examples.text_en: The fanaticism of the group worried the town.
examples.text_zh: 这个团体的狂热让镇上的人担忧。

examples.text_en: He told a fanciful story about a far land.
examples.text_zh: 他讲了一个关于遥远国度的离奇故事。

examples.text_en: Her fanciful ideas were hard to believe.
examples.text_zh: 她那些异想天开的想法让人难以相信。

examples.text_en: A great fanfare met the king at the door.
examples.text_zh: 一阵响亮的号角声在门口迎接国王。

examples.text_en: They gave him a fanfare and a big party.
examples.text_zh: 他们为他奏响号角，还办了一场大聚会。

examples.text_en: The pianist played a lively fantasia.
examples.text_zh: 钢琴家演奏了一首活泼的幻想曲。

examples.text_en: Her fantasia mixed several folk songs.
examples.text_zh: 她的幻想曲混合了好几首民歌。

examples.text_en: The change had far-reaching effects on the town.
examples.text_zh: 这一变化对小镇有深远的影响。

examples.text_en: Their far-reaching plan touched every part of life.
examples.text_zh: 他们影响深远的计划触及生活的每个方面。

examples.text_en: The meeting turned into a complete farce.
examples.text_zh: 会议变成了一场十足的闹剧。

examples.text_en: The trial was a legal farce.
examples.text_zh: 这场审判是一场法律闹剧。

examples.text_en: Organic farming is growing in this area.
examples.text_zh: 有机农业在这个地区正在发展。

examples.text_en: He learned farming from his father.
examples.text_zh: 他从父亲那里学会了耕作。

examples.text_en: The sow gave birth to a farrow.
examples.text_zh: 母猪产下了一窝小猪。

examples.text_en: A farrow of eight pigs was born.
examples.text_zh: 一窝八只小猪出生了。

examples.text_en: The fascia over the door was red and new.
examples.text_zh: 门上方的招牌是新的，红红的。

examples.text_en: A bright fascia showed the name of the store.
examples.text_zh: 一块明亮的招牌写着店的名字。

examples.text_en: The book tells a fascinating story.
examples.text_zh: 这本书讲了一个迷人的故事。

examples.text_en: Her talk on stars was fascinating.
examples.text_zh: 她关于星星的讲话十分迷人。

examples.text_en: She has a deep fascination with stars.
examples.text_zh: 她对星星十分着迷。

examples.text_en: His fascination with birds began early.
examples.text_zh: 他对鸟类的着迷开始得很早。

examples.text_en: The fastener on the box was hard to open.
examples.text_zh: 盒子上的扣件很难打开。

examples.text_en: She used a small fastener to hold the cloth.
examples.text_zh: 她用一个小扣件把布固定住。

examples.text_en: He is fastidious about the food he eats.
examples.text_zh: 他对自己吃的东西很挑剔。

examples.text_en: Her fastidious taste made shopping hard.
examples.text_zh: 她挑剔的品味让买东西变得很难。

examples.text_en: They hid in a mountain fastness.
examples.text_zh: 他们躲进了一处山间要塞。

examples.text_en: The castle was a strong fastness.
examples.text_zh: 这座城堡是一座坚固的要塞。

examples.text_en: His fatalism made him accept the bad news.
examples.text_zh: 他的宿命论让他平静地接受了坏消息。

examples.text_en: The fatalism of the group was hard to change.
examples.text_zh: 这个团体的宿命论很难改变。

examples.text_en: That fateful day changed her life.
examples.text_zh: 那个决定性的日子改变了她的生活。

examples.text_en: They met on a fateful night.
examples.text_zh: 他们在一个重大的夜晚相遇。
